verdict: CALIBRATE SELECTIVE (calibrate_selective.py): the honest win at the data ceiling -- report WHICH predictions to trust, without a new model or new data. Held-out K562, 112 KOs. PER-KO: confidence = retrieval margin x neighbour agreement (no truth leakage). Answering only the most-confident 50% of knockouts raises recall@50 to 0.52 vs 0.40 answering all (+0.12); the top 25% reach 0.68. So the tool can say 'I can call this knockout' vs 'measure this one'. PER-GENE: neighbour consensus splits each top-50 into trustworthy vs speculative -- the ~1 consensus-backed names per 50 (consensus>=0.3) hit 0.87 precision vs 0.18 for the speculative rest, so the few confident calls on each list are flaggable. This converts a flat ~0.5 recall into a calibrated tool: high precision on the subset it is sure about, honest abstention on the broad/private knockouts it provably cannot get (which error_localization/denoise_test showed are the non-reproducing ones). Deterministic.
